product_family: AI-native documentation platform; sub-products include GitBook AI (writing assistance), GitBook Agent (stale content detection), GitBook Assistant (ask-your-docs chatbot), and Git Sync (repo-linked doc updates)

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: GitBook completed a SOC 2 Type II audit, which certifies the effectiveness of our security processes at every level of the company - from server architecture down to employee access. (Trust Center at security.gitbook.com lists SOC 2 Type II under Compliance.)

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Trust Center at security.gitbook.com lists ISO 27001:2022 under Compliance. Blog announcement (Sept 2023) confirmed initial ISO/IEC 27001 certification; trust center now shows the 2022 revision, consistent with the October 2025 transition deadline having passed.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: We are SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR compliant. Privacy Statement: If you're visiting us from the EU, we are compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). GitBook has adopted a data processing addendum with Standard Contractual Clauses.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of HIPAA compliance on the trust center, security FAQ, privacy statement, enterprise page, or pricing page. No BAA offering found. GitBook's security FAQ does not list HIPAA among supported compliance frameworks.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No PCI DSS certification or attestation found on any GitBook-domain page. GitBook explicitly delegates payment card processing to Stripe; card data never reaches GitBook servers.

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27017 certification on any GitBook-domain page.

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27018 certification on any GitBook-domain page.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR certification or self-assessment on any GitBook-domain page.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of FedRAMP authorization on any GitBook-domain page.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 AI management certification on any GitBook-domain page.

privacy.ai_training_note: GitBook AI Policy explicitly states: 'Customer data is never shared with OpenAI or used to train any AI models.' GitBook uses OpenAI as its AI provider for features like the AI Assistant and GitBook Agent. No opt-out mechanism is described because training is stated to be off by default for all tiers. No tier-level differences in this policy are documented publicly.
privacy.data_region: United States (Google Cloud). CDN caching may occur globally via Cloudflare; application-layer data access is validated through US-based servers. No EU or other regional data residency option is offered.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS/TLS for all traffic including custom domains (via Let's Encrypt and Cloudflare)

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Multiple layers of AES-256 and AES-128 encryption on Google Cloud Platform

security.name: Cloud infrastructure
security.value: Google Cloud Platform (primary); Cloudflare (CDN/DDoS); Vercel (hosting layer); PlanetScale (database)

security.name: Tenant isolation
security.value: Each organization's data is logically isolated from other tenants; access automatically revoked on user removal

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-based permissions (reader, editor, admin) enforced at API level; SAML SSO on Enterprise tier

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Penetration testing performed (listed as a security control in trust center); test report available on request via trust center

security.name: Business continuity
security.value: Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans established and tested (listed in trust center controls)

security.name: Cyber insurance
security.value: Cybersecurity insurance maintained (listed in trust center controls)

security.name: Vulnerability management
security.value: Responsible disclosure program active; security bugs reported to security@gitbook.com

security.name: Data deletion on offboarding
security.value: Customer data deleted upon leaving (listed in trust center Data and privacy controls)

security.name: Payment data
security.value: Credit card data processed by Stripe only; GitBook stores only partial card details and optional billing address

products.name: GitBook Free
products.data_scope: Public and private documentation content, user account data (email, username); SOC 2 + ISO 27001 protections apply
products.notes: 1 user, basic SSO (Google/email domain). No SAML SSO.

products.name: GitBook Premium
products.data_scope: Public branded docs sites; same data protections as Free
products.notes: $65/site/month + $12/user/month. No SAML SSO or legal/security reviews.

products.name: GitBook Ultimate
products.data_scope: Documentation content + AI-processed queries via OpenAI; customer data explicitly not used for AI training
products.notes: $249/site/month + $12/user/month. Includes AI Assistant and GitBook Agent. No SAML SSO.

products.name: GitBook Enterprise
products.data_scope: Full documentation corpus + AI features; legal and security reviews included; SAML SSO for access control
products.notes: Custom pricing. Adds SAML SSO, white-glove migration, 1:1 support, custom integrations, legal and security reviews.

compare.pricing_model: Per-site + per-user subscription (Free / Premium at $65/site/mo / Ultimate at $249/site/mo / Enterprise at custom pricing)
compare.data_residency: US only (Google Cloud); no EU or regional residency option offered

flags: No HIPAA compliance claim and no BAA offering were found, so GitBook is not suitable for healthcare PHI workloads.
Data residency: US-only storage on Google Cloud; no EU or regional residency option, which may affect GDPR-sensitive enterprise buyers in Europe

ISO 27001 version: original 2023 certification was likely ISO 27001:2013; trust center now shows ISO 27001:2022, implying a successful transition before the October 2025 deadline - this is positive but the exact transition date is not publicly confirmed

AI provider dependency: GitBook uses OpenAI as its AI provider; customers whose data flows through AI features should note OpenAI is a subprocessor, though GitBook states no customer data is used for training
SaaS-only: no self-hosting or on-premises option available, meaning all data resides on GitBook-controlled infrastructure
